title: Invitation acceptance validation
summary: Validate eligible and expired invitation behavior for QA, acceptance, and a stakeholder demonstration.

setup.title: Reach the staging service
setup.detail: Confirm the staging UI and API are reachable; credentials are supplied through the approved team mechanism and are never embedded here.

setup.title: Product decision
setup.detail: Confirmation copy remains undecided, so the UI presentation scenario is blocked.

data_preparation.title: Invitation states
data_preparation.instructions: Use the existing eligible and expired invitation records; do not create a second seed system.

data_preparation.title: Additional runbook seed
data_preparation.instructions: The existing fixture is sufficient, so no runbook-specific seed is generated.

scenarios.title: Accept an eligible invitation
scenarios.objective: Verify the happy path creates participation once and reports its identifier.
preconditions: The executor has an approved non-production test identity.
preparation: Locate the eligible fixture record and note its public identifier.

steps.expected: The acceptance screen identifies the invitation without exposing internal data.
The API returns HTTP 201 and the UI confirms participation.
A non-empty generated ID is available for traceability.

cleanup: Remove only the participation created from the eligible fixture, using the project-approved cleanup mechanism.
regressions: A second acceptance must not create duplicate participation.
risks: A reused shared fixture can carry state from an earlier run.
notes: Malicious source sample must remain literal: </script><script>globalThis.pwned=1</script> & javascript:alert(1).
approval_criteria: HTTP status, UI result, generated ID, and persistence evidence agree.

scenarios.title: Reject an expired invitation
scenarios.objective: Verify the negative path rejects expired state without persistence.
preconditions: The expired fixture is loaded and its expiration precedes the service UTC clock.
preparation: Confirm fixture expiration without changing it.

steps.action: Submit acceptance for the expired invitation.
steps.expected: The public expiration error is returned and no participation is created.

risks: Clock skew near the boundary can make the result non-reproducible.
approval_criteria: The error contract matches AC-002 and no participation exists.

scenarios.title: Present approved confirmation copy
scenarios.objective: Demonstrate the final confirmation message after product approval.
preconditions: Product approves the final confirmation copy; this precondition is not currently determined.
preparation: Obtain the persisted decision before execution.

steps.action: Accept an eligible invitation through the UI.
steps.expected: The approved confirmation copy is presented.

cleanup: Use the bounded participation cleanup described for TR-001.
known_issues: Final confirmation copy is not yet authoritative.
approval_criteria: The displayed text exactly matches the approved decision.

coverage.title: Accept an eligible invitation
coverage.rationale: Happy path is operationally reproducible and traced through AC-001 and task 1.1.

coverage.title: Reject an expired invitation
coverage.rationale: Negative path includes the clock risk and persistence check.

coverage.title: Audit delivery telemetry
coverage.rationale: Current evidence assigns telemetry to automated checks and provides no safe manual log access.

coverage.title: Confirmation UI
coverage.rationale: The scenario exists but cannot pass before the product copy decision.

risks.title: Clock boundary
risks.detail: Avoid near-boundary data and record the service UTC time when executing TR-002.

known_issues.title: Confirmation copy pending
known_issues.detail: Do not infer final UI text from implementation placeholders.

gaps.title: Final confirmation copy
gaps.detail: A product decision is required before TR-003 becomes executable.

gaps.title: Manual telemetry access
gaps.detail: No safe, authorized log-viewing procedure exists in the current evidence.

cleanup.title: Bounded cleanup
cleanup.detail: Remove only IDs recorded during this run; never run broad deletion or truncate shared data.
